# Changelog

## Bug Fixes
- The item was unusable (because I accidentally removed an important class)
- Fixed a crash that occurred when using the item while looking up at the sky

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Onyx-i7/VillagerContractsExtended/compare/1.3.7...1.3.8

# Changelog

## Added
- A scroll bar was added to the GUI, allowing you to navigate the list when there are a large number of mods installed without having to search

## Removed
- The Cooldown, AutoName, and other unnecessary options were removed to keep the configuration cleaner and allow me to focus on potential compatibility issues or bug fixes
- Chat messages were removed because they were, frankly, a bit unnecessary

## Bug Fixes
- There were duplicate professions due to the `autoDetectVillagers` and `validContracts` settings. Now, `validContracts` includes an empty list, though it will still be available to add any other professions not detected by `autoDetectVillagers`, following this example format: `Farmer=minecraft:farmer;farmer` or `Tool Smith=minecraft:blacksmith;tool`

**Most of the changes were structural**

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Onyx-i7/VillagerContractsExtended/compare/1.3.6...1.3.7

# Changelog

### Added

- Added a `professionCosts` option to specify the costs for each villager individually using this format: `profession_id=COST_TYPE:cost_value;amount`. Example: `minecraft:farmer=ITEM:minecraft:wheat_seeds;3` or for experience: `minecraft:fisherman=EXPERIENCE:0;5`

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed a rare crash that occurred when the mod attempted to use a translation from another mod while the `useModTranslations` setting was enabled

### Removed

- Removed `generateVillagerAttempts` since it was no longer used in the code due to optimizations, I plan to redesign the mod’s configuration

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Onyx-i7/VillagerContractsExtended/compare/1.3.5...1.3.6

# Changelog

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where translations provided by other mods were not updated correctly when changing the game's language

## Added
- Added the `useModTranslations` option to configure whether to use mod translations or the original English names
- Added the `professionGameStages` option, which specifies the specific GameStages levels required for each profession
- Added Russian translations

## Improvements
- Improved the English translations

## New Contributors
* @MrKoteo made their first contribution in https://github.com/Onyx-i7/VillagerContractsExtended/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Onyx-i7/VillagerContractsExtended/compare/1.3.4...1.3.5

# Changelog

## Added
- Added the GUI texture

## Improvements
- The search system has been improved you can now find mods and villager professions previously, it only searched for mods
- Now, when you perform a search, select the result that best matches what you're looking for
- The GUI now includes localizations for mods villagers based on the mods original translations

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Onyx-i7/VillagerContractsExtended/compare/1.3.3...1.3.4
